audit.recode_to: No change of kind (fixed second-syllable + even-syllable alternation, dominant, with a minority prototonic class already carried as caveat). Cell-level refinement only: the disyllable cell '01' is not supported -- Menovshchikov 1997:81 says disyllables are predominantly initial-stressed and Krauss 1985:178 n.5 says disyllable stress marks are not necessarily significant; consider '10' or flag disyllables as indeterminate.
audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding Krauss 1985 pp.177-178 passage in the domain quotation/the domain locator is verbatim in the ERIC text we hold (cent2128/, lines 9946-9960), including the Rubtsova 1954:16 quotation; but the record's own quote/cite/loc/grade/sources fields are empty, so the evidence should be promoted from the database-check note into those fields. (2) Deciding source: a 1985 dedicated prosody chapter by Krauss (philological, from Menovshchikov's 1964 accent-marked transcriptions), corroborated by two held primary statements -- Menovshchikov 1964:107 (several equal stresses 'через слог') and Menovshchikov 1997:81 (2-4-6-8 model for the overwhelming majority, 1-3-5-7 rare, long vowel disrupts rhythm). tone.quote: 5.1.0. Фонологические сведения. Состав гласных фонем: а, и, у, ы. Состав согласных фонем: б, (ф), в, г, г̌, й, (йь), к, қ, л, лъ, м, н, (нь), ң, п, з, с, ш, т, ҳ, ч, (ц), ˀ. Ударение в двусложных словах падает преимущественно на первый слог ... в трехсложных — преимущественно на второй: кугы́млъа ‘волна’, амту́гын ‘много’, ану́лъа ‘рост’, мара́му ‘сюда’. ... Долгий гласный «сбивает» ритм ударения
tone.translation: 5.1.0. Phonological information. Vowel phonemes: a, i, u, y. Consonant phonemes: b, (f), v, g, ..., (ts), ˀ. Stress in disyllabic words falls predominantly on the first syllable ... in trisyllabic words predominantly on the second: kugýml'a 'wave', amtúgyn 'many', anúl'a 'growth', marámu 'hither'. ... A long vowel 'throws off' the stress rhythm
